title: Steam Wishlist Purchase Conversion
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=steam:player event=wishlist
| stats count(eval(status="purchased")) as purchased_titles, count as total_titles by category
| eval conversion_pct=round(100*purchased_titles/total_titles,1)
| where total_titles>0
| sort - conversion_pct
description: Uses Steam wishlist exports telemetry to monitor how many wishlisted games actually turned into purchases in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for categories that convert better than others during sales, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Steam wishlist exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Category table of wishlist conversion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It frames how many wishlisted games actually turned into purchases so you can spot categories that convert better than others during sales before it becomes annoying.
